yolo.scope: in-memory image to detections; excludes disk read, model load and drawing; CPU warmup performed

opencv.scope: in-memory image to detections; excludes disk read, model load and drawing; CPU warmup performed

protocol: Original test membership; deterministic within-group 80/20 train/val. Image-disjoint, NOT board-group-disjoint.
notes: OpenCV requires aligned defect-free template; YOLO consumes only tested image
OpenCV has no defect classification; compare localization columns only
Validation selects confidence. Test metrics are descriptive, not a production guarantee
Timed on this machine with possible concurrent workloads; not a controlled hardware benchmark
